brief: Crews must inspect all intake and exhaust louvres for blockage by wind-blown debris, leaf litter, nesting material, and accumulated dust, with obstruction above one quarter of the free area requiring clearance before the forecast heat event (SOP-015). Stiff linkages must be lubricated and re-proved, and any recirculation suspected between an exhaust and a nearby intake recorded at the intake temperature and escalated for assessment (SOP-015). Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value, and the period, and restore the full rating only when the underlying condition has been corrected and verified (MG-021).
